messages:
Sam T: Heads-up — noticed the cost console shows cache savings > billed savings for some routes. anyone else see this?
Ida M: saw the spike on /chat-rewrite last night, looked like prefetch credits + hotpath credits both applied to same invocation.
Sam T: my suspicion: attribution window is duplicating prefetch refunds when KV hits are resolved later. we should surface raw per-invocation credits.
Jon R: agreed. per-invocation fields would help debugging but cardinality concerns. can't blow up telemetry.
Priya: sampling can help. deterministic sampling by tenant+route keeps A/B comparable. 1% baseline?
Sam T: proposal: add `cache_credited_tokens` + `model_sku` to router telemetry event, then expose sampled aggregates and extrapolate. rollout behind flag.
Ida M: dashboard UX question — show per-model OR per-route? both have use cases. per-model for cost engineering, per-route for product owners.
Jon R: we should keep both but aggregate default to amortized per-route to avoid overwhelming product dashboards. devs can drill to per-model.
Sam T: draft telemetry payload (for discussion):
```
{
  "invocation_id": "inv-01F...",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "route": "/chat-rewrite",
  "model_sku": "rwx-13b-q4",
  "input_tokens": 120,
  "output_tokens": 80,
  "cache_credited_tokens": 40,
  "prefetch_credited": 25
}
```
Priya: if we add `model_sku` we should hash it or map to SKU ids in telemetry to avoid leaking model names in logs. also add a `sampling_seed` field.
Lee C: for quotas: if net tokens = gross - cache_credits, quotas need to surface both numbers. product teams expect to see gross usage for quota enforcement.
Ida M: dashboard suggestion: two tabs — "Net usage" (default, amortized) and "Gross + Credits" (detailed). visuals: sparkline for savings horizon, stacked bars split by prefetch vs hotpath. toggle to show sampled vs extrapolated.
Jon R: also add an alert rule generator: when (gross - net)/gross > 0.3 show a warning. reduces surprise for tenants with heavy prefetch.
Sam T: rollout plan idea: 1) flag on for telemetry (no UI) + canary 10 tenants, 2) sample telemetry at 1% with deterministic hashing, 3) dashboard beta in Console for selected customers, 4) full enable and 30d backfill.
Priya: backfill: retention optics — we can reconstruct credits for 30d if we store compacted per-shard aggregates. need cost estimate.
Ida M: operational note: add `route_cache_crediting` feature flag and RBAC by org so enterprise customers can opt-out.
Jon R: action items: I'll sketch the telemetry schema and cardinality numbers today. Priya — you own the flag + rollout schedule. Sam — dashboard mocks and API RFC. Ida — coord with compliance on hashed SKU approach.
Sam T: I'll open an RFC and proto PR after lunch. if no objections i'll land the RFC this week :thumbsup:
Priya: LGTM :+1:
Ida M: ok, will sync Thurs at 11.
ops-bot: Deploy queued for canary group at 2024-11-14 02:00 UTC
Sam T: noted, thanks everyone.
